name: Black Adam
summary: Shazam's evil twin, with five thousand years of grudges. Teth-Adam, an ancient champion corrupted by power, rules the nation of Kahndaq and wields the same magic lightning as Billy Batson.
origin: Black Adam was a villain built for one story, and he has been stealing the show ever since. Otto Binder and C. C. Beck created him for Fawcett Comics' The Marvel Family #1 in December 1945: Teth-Adam, an ancient Egyptian given the wizard Shazam's powers thousands of years before Billy Batson, who went bad and was banished. In that first tale he was tricked into saying the magic word and crumbled to dust. DC licensed the Fawcett heroes in the 1970s and later bought them outright, and Adam came back as the fierce ruler of the fictional nation of Kahndaq. Strong, fast, almost impossible to hurt and armed with magic lightning, he honestly believes he's the hero.
creators: Otto Binder and C. C. Beck
powers: Wisdom and knowledge granted by the gods

storyline.title: The first champion
storyline.beat: Black Adam debuts in Fawcett's The Marvel Family #1 as an ancient Egyptian given magic powers who turned evil. He is defeated in the same story.

storyline.title: Back from the dust
storyline.beat: After DC licenses the Fawcett heroes, Black Adam returns as a recurring foe of Captain Marvel.

storyline.title: A homeland
storyline.beat: Jerry Ordway's The Power of Shazam! retells his history and links him to the fictional nation of Kahndaq.

storyline.title: Antihero
storyline.beat: Geoff Johns has Black Adam join the Justice Society, trying to redeem himself in his own violent way.

storyline.title: Love and war
storyline.beat: Adam becomes ruler of Kahndaq, marries Isis and starts a family. When they are killed, his rage sparks a world war.

gossip.text: He was defeated in his very first appearance: tricked into saying the magic word, he turned mortal and aged to dust.
Black Adam was created by DC.
gossip.truth: He was created at Fawcett Comics in 1945. DC later licensed, then bought, the Fawcett heroes.

gossip.text: Dwayne Johnson was linked to the role for over a decade before the 2022 film.
He rules the fictional Middle Eastern nation of Kahndaq.

quiz.q: Which nation does Black Adam rule?
Who is Black Adam's classic arch-enemy?
quiz.why: He was created as Captain Marvel's dark counterpart.

quiz.q: Which publisher first created Black Adam?

theme.tagline: Lightning, royalty and absolutely no apologies.

timeline.title: The first champion
timeline.note: The Marvel Family #1 introduces Teth-Adam, an ancient Egyptian given magic power who turns to evil.

timeline.title: The Power of Shazam!
timeline.note: Jerry Ordway's graphic novel reinvents Adam as a darker, more complex foe.

timeline.title: Joins the JSA
timeline.note: Black Adam takes a probationary seat on the Justice Society, leaning into his antihero side.

timeline.title: World War III
timeline.note: Shattered by grief in the weekly series 52, Adam rampages across the globe.

timeline.title: Justice Leaguer
timeline.note: Adam joins the Justice League in the Infinite Frontier era, a hero strictly on his own terms.

timeline.title: The Rock as Adam
timeline.note: Dwayne Johnson finally stars in the Black Adam movie after years of chasing the role.
